question: What spiritual conquest is attributed to the one who properly uses this rosary?
premises: A practitioner is the agent of conquest
All gods are said to be conquered
The gods include Brahma, Vishnu, and Indra
inference: By him all the gods, including Brahma, Vishnu, and Indra, are conquered.
plain_english: By him all the gods—Brahma, Vishnu, Indra, and the rest—are conquered.
